title: Deep learning screens LabMol compounds for antiplasmodial activity
summary: Deep-learning QSAR models for parasite activity and cytotoxicity prioritized commercial candidates for assay. Primary Table 3 reports LabMol-152 EC50 values of 0.049 and 0.078 µM against 3D7 and W2; LabMol-149 values were 1.450 and 0.509 µM, inconsistent with the abstract’s under-500-nM claim. The study reports in-vitro results only; the model ranked existing compounds rather than generating them.
organization: University Center of Anápolis–UniEVANGÉLICA; Federal University of Goiás

evidence.tested: Table 3 reports strain-specific EC50 and COS-7 cytotoxicity results for tested compounds.
evidence.unknown: Abstract/results inconsistency for LabMol-149 preserved; no animal or clinical evidence; earlier public version/chemical prior art unresolved.
evidence.ai_role: Activity and cytotoxicity models ranked an existing library and filters/human inspection selected compounds for assay.

source_review.scope: publisher primary full text. Material checked for the specific claims stated in the record.
